plan.title: D2 suppression hash includes #1270 discrepancy-line fields

narratives.Description: Session-start triage summary uses a 4-hour D2 suppression window keyed on cache state. After #1270, the rendered output includes a `[triage:scope]` discrepancy line driven by `in_flight_filesystem`, `in_flight_cache_scoped`, and `triage_scope_configured`. When only the discrepancy line flips (cache catches up), suppression incorrectly holds because those fields are not in the hash key.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Add a canonical suppression-key helper in `packages/core/src/triage/summary/index.ts` (or welcome module) hashing structured fields: include `in_flight_filesystem`, `in_flight_cache_scoped`, `triage_scope_configured` plus existing headline fields from `summaryResultToRecord`.
2. Wire session-start / triage:welcome emission to compare against last `summary-history.jsonl` record and skip only when key unchanged within 4h.
3. Add test in `packages/core/src/triage/summary/index.test.ts` proving discrepancy-only flip invalidates suppression; update AGENTS.md session-start step 3 field list in `content/templates/agents-entry.md` + `task agents:refresh`.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator starting a session, I want the triage one-liner to re-emit when the scope discrepancy line appears or resolves, so that I see accurate in-flight state within the 4-hour window.
narratives.Overview: Follow-up to #1270 / PR #1277 — extend D2 suppression key per issue #1279 acceptance criteria.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a summary record where only `in_flight_cache_scoped` changes (discrepancy line toggles), when the suppression key is computed, then it differs from the prior record's key.
Given a unit test simulating filesystem in-flight constant while cache-scoped count catches up, when suppression comparison runs, then emission is not suppressed.
Given AGENTS.md session-start ritual step 3 after refresh, when read, then it explicitly lists the structured fields in the D2 suppression hash. Closes #1279.
